item.text: The campaign and ad group are active and scheduled; both approved posts were accepted. The single ad group has a $350 lifetime cap (with a $31.82 daily pacing budget), targets the UK and Ireland on iOS and Android, and uses timeline placement. I’ll check delivery during the flight and pull final metrics after the scheduled end.

After the first day, delivery has spent $31.78 and generated 20,267 impressions and 17 link clicks. I’m adjusting the daily pacing budget to $28.93 for the remaining 11 days so the lifetime cap can cover the full 12-day flight.
Mid-flight (through 24 August), spend is $166.19 for 159,594 impressions and 91 link clicks. That pace leaves room under the $350 cap for the remaining six days.

The flight ended on 30 August, and I paused the ad group.

- **Spend:** $331.81 of the $350 budget
- **Impressions:** 347,712

X couldn’t measure free trial starts because there’s no site pixel, so the campaign optimized for link clicks.
